solution.title: NTLM Elimination & SMB Signing — Legacy Authentication Hardening (Intune)

products.name: NTLM Elimination & SMB Signing — Legacy Authentication Hardening (Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: Eliminate NTLM (LM/NTLMv1 first, then NTLM) and enforce SMB signing on Windows 10/11 via an Intune Settings Catalog policy — refuse weak auth, defeat SMB relay, close insecure guest logons & unauthenticated RPC — deployed audit-first so nothing breaks. Resolves ~7 assessment findings. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Shut down the legacy authentication attackers rely on

Your Windows endpoints still accept and emit the weak authentication that fuels credential theft, NTLM relay, and lateral movement — LM/NTLMv1 responses, unsigned SMB, insecure guest logons, and unauthenticated RPC — and most tenants have never turned it off. This solution eliminates NTLM and enforces SMB signing on Intune-managed Windows 10/11 endpoints via a Settings Catalog policy, using the exact Local Policies\Security Options, MS Security Guide, and SMB settings that harden the stack — deployed audit-first and rollback-ready.

Audit before you enforce — nothing breaks blind

NTLM can't be switched off blind: a lingering app, NAS, scanner, or service that still needs it will break. So the package puts you through Microsoft's Restrict NTLM: Audit settings first to discover where NTLM is actually used, then walks you into enforcement in waves — the Kerberos-first posture Microsoft itself is moving toward.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; the policies you create (NTLM-SMB Hardening - Pilot, NTLM Audit - Pilot) are named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable security engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates, including registry-anchor checks.

Resolves ~7 Windows Client assessment findings

  • LAN Manager authentication level → Send NTLMv2 only. Refuse LM & NTLM
  • NTLM SSP minimum session security — clients and servers (NTLMv2 + 128-bit)
  • SMB signing — client and server (digitally sign always)
  • Insecure guest logons disabled
  • Restrict unauthenticated RPC clients

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the threat closed (LM/NTLMv1, NTLM relay, unsigned SMB, guest logons, unauthenticated RPC), the exact settings and their registry anchors, and the audit-first / Kerberos-first posture aligned with Microsoft's NTLM deprecation.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Intune enrollment, supported edition, NTLM event-log access, SMB-signing-capable servers, Kerberos/DNS health, a pilot group) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to audit NTLM first, then build the named NTLM-SMB Hardening - Pilot Settings Catalog policy with all seven settings, deploy, validate real workloads, then pilot and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — hardening-policy discovery, per-device applied-state validation, a coverage report, safe remediation that scaffolds the policy, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (LM/NTLMv1 refused, SMB signing both ends, broken-share and Kerberos-fallback fixes, baseline-conflict handling) plus Best Practices for audit-first rollout and SMB-signing readiness.

Focused, not a duplicate baseline

This product owns the NTLM-elimination + SMB-signing slice and cross-references the CIS Windows 11 and DISA STIG solutions rather than rebuilding them — so you get the legacy-auth fix without paying for, or colliding with, a full baseline.

The bottom line

LM/NTLMv1 refused, NTLM audited then eliminated where safe, SMB signing required on both ends, guest logons and unauthenticated RPC shut down — a materially smaller credential-theft and relay surface, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • NTLMHARD-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for NTLM/SMB legacy-auth hardening
    • NTLMHARD-Remediation.ps1 — safely scaffold and assign the NTLM/SMB hardening Settings Catalog policy
    • NTLMHARD-Report.ps1 — coverage report for Windows devices (hardening applied or not)
    • NTLMHARD-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — set the target group for the NTLM/SMB hardening policy
    • NTLMHARD-Validation.ps1 — validate assignment and per-device applied state of the hardening policy

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
